title: Southern Exposure | KEY.co
description_expanded: Moving to the second floor, you'll find an inviting open floor plan that seamlessly integrates indoor and outdoor living. The updated kitchen, equipped with stainless-steel appliances, beckons aspiring chefs and provides bar seating for three. The adjacent dining area comfortably seats four and opens up to a large wrap-around side porch. Here, you can indulge in alfresco dining for four, accompanied by two chaise loungers that offer breathtaking gulf views. This is the ideal spot to witness the most magnificent sunsets. The living room is a haven of relaxation, enveloped by windows that frame the mesmerizing gulf views. Sink into the plush sofas, offering ample seating for everyone, and enjoy your favorite shows on the large mounted flat screen TV. Step onto the covered beachfront balcony, accessible from the living room, where bar top seating for four invites you to admire the ever-changing beachfront panorama and immerse yourself in the beauty of the sunset. A convenient half bath completes the living area.

Features: Open-air porch TV Deck Dryer Washer Internet
